reason: Zahir Insight - faktur penjualan berstatus draft untuk laporan Penjualan per Pelanggan (pilih faktur); sisa = nilai faktur
name: penjualan_draft_faktur
query:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
      g.id                              AS transaction_id,
      g.tanggal::date                   AS d,
      g.nojurnal,
      g.contact_id,
      g.department_id,
      g.project_id,
      cu.classification_id              AS customer_classification_id,
      sm.contact_id                     AS salesman_id,
      sm.classification_id              AS salesman_classification_id,
      COALESCE(s.nilaikurs, 1)::numeric AS kurs,
      COALESCE(s.saldo, 0)::numeric     AS saldo
    FROM g_jurnal g
    JOIN sales s          ON s.transaction_id = g.id
    LEFT JOIN cardfile cu ON cu.contact_id = g.contact_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (   -- salesman faktur (ambil satu bila lebih dari satu)
      SELECT e.contact_id, cs.classification_id
      FROM employees e
      LEFT JOIN cardfile cs ON cs.contact_id = e.contact_id
      WHERE e.transaction_id = g.id AND e.type = 'salesman'
      ORDER BY e.contact_id
      LIMIT 1
    ) sm ON TRUE
    WHERE g.type = 'sales_invoices'
      AND g.status = 'draft'
  ) G1
  WHERE 1=1 {andWhere}
),
baris AS (
  -- nilai per baris faktur; harga/qty/diskon dari baris DO (parent) bila faktur dibuat dari pengiriman
  SELECT
    i.id AS item_id,
    i.transaction_id,
    COALESCE(p.jumlahf1, i.jumlahf1, 0)::numeric
      * COALESCE(p.hargaf1, i.hargaf1, 0)::numeric
      * (1 - COALESCE(p.discount, i.discount, 0)::numeric / 100) AS dpp
  FROM inv
  JOIN itemsale i      ON i.transaction_id = inv.transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN itemsale p ON p.id = i.parent_id
),
pajak AS (
  -- tarif pajak per baris = pajak dengan tax_id terbesar
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (it.item_id) it.item_id, COALESCE(t.persentase, 0)::numeric AS pct
  FROM baris b
  JOIN items_taxes it ON it.item_id = b.item_id
  JOIN tax t          ON t.id = it.tax_id
  ORDER BY it.item_id, it.tax_id DESC
),
faktur AS (
  SELECT
    inv.transaction_id, inv.d, inv.nojurnal, inv.contact_id, inv.department_id, inv.saldo,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(b.dpp * inv.kurs * (1 + COALESCE(px.pct, 0) / 100)), 0), 2) AS total
  FROM inv
  LEFT JOIN baris b  ON b.transaction_id = inv.transaction_id
  LEFT JOIN pajak px ON px.item_id = b.item_id
  GROUP BY inv.transaction_id, inv.d, inv.nojurnal, inv.contact_id, inv.department_id, inv.saldo
)
SELECT
  f.transaction_id,
  f.nojurnal                              AS no_faktur,
  f.d                                     AS tanggal,
  (SELECT MAX(tp.due_date)::date FROM term_of_payments tp WHERE tp.data_id = f.transaction_id) AS jatuh_tempo,
  f.contact_id,
  COALESCE(c.kode, '')                    AS kode_pelanggan,
  COALESCE(c.perusahaan, '')              AS nama_pelanggan,
  COALESCE(k.klasifikasi, '')             AS klasifikasi,
  COALESCE(dp.nama, '')                   AS dept,
  f.total,
  f.total                                 AS saldo
FROM faktur f
LEFT JOIN cardfile c  ON c.contact_id = f.contact_id
LEFT JOIN klascard k  ON k.id = c.classification_id
LEFT JOIN dept dp     ON dp.id = f.department_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(k.klasifikasi, ''), COALESCE(c.perusahaan, ''), f.contact_id, f.d, f.nojurnal, f.transaction_id {andOrder} {limit}
